Name: RTX/ARAX
Notes: SmartAPI registers the TRAPI base URL with the API version in the path (.../api/arax/v1.4), so the version moves when TRAPI does.

Name: ARS
Notes: Calls SmartAPI on boot to fetch registration data

Name: ARS Test Server
Notes: A small server that periodically runs performance tests on a cron job

Name: Tier 1: ElasticSearch (KGX split out by data source)
Notes: Actual data later, called by retriever

Name: Jaeger (OTel)
Notes: Third-party software, not a Translator component: we deploy upstream Jaeger. Only the chart is ours.

Name: Node Annotator
Notes: Registered in SmartAPI without an infores, and its ci/test servers carry no x-maturity and are declared http:// not https://. SmartAPI registers it at biothings.ci.transltr.io/annotator, which does not serve the OpenAPI document; annotator.ci.transltr.io does. Both were live on 2026-08-31, so the ci base URL is recorded here rather than pulled. Prod serves its OpenAPI at openapi.json rather than the webapp/openapi.json that ci and test use, so it carries a per-environment override; ci and test are the intended convention going forward.

Name: BioThings Pending API
Notes: Hosts a number of APIs from the previous phase. Some have moved to CoCo's own ES server (nodenorm, annotator, nameres) and the BTE ones are expected to be removed, but this host is likely to stay live while any of its APIs are still in use, and could host tier 2 knowledge graph APIs later.

Name: Ploverdb
Notes: The SmartAPI record is registered as infores:rtx-kg2 — the knowledge graph — not as PloverDB, the server that hosts it. Its servers are kg2cploverdb.*.transltr.io.

Name: Retriever (query API)
Notes: API server to route calls to the different tiers

Name: Test Harness
Notes: The Test Harness uses Smart API to grab the urls for the various components it tests. It isn't really hosted, but is a spawned python script that runs on the RENCI server.
